title: a harness word or an Orca verb inside the quoted text or a heredoc body of a data command is data, not a command, and passes
source: intended: docs/decisions.md v0.1.2 fixes, J41 (it supersedes the known limit of N-24 and the commit-message clauses of N-19 and B3-19)
intended: docs/decisions.md, section "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories" (the guard denies only what starts an agent)
intent: INTENDED behavior since v0.1.2 (J41). The guard reads a Bash line with a shell lexer: separators split commands only outside quotes, a quoted word of a data command that holds whitespace is text, and a heredoc body is data unless a shell on the line reads it. So a commit message, a message body or a roster written through a heredoc no longer trips the guard. Before, the splitter cut at parentheses, backticks and newlines without reading quotes and judged the text as commands.

values:
cat > roster.md <<EOF
| w1 | claude --resume abc |
EOF
orca orchestration send --to dispatch:ctx_x --body "ask the owner to run jitso build save cp-x"
orca orchestration send --to dispatch:ctx_x --body 'ask the owner to run jitso setup hook'
git commit -m "docs: orchestration worker-start is denied"
